strings.seo.faq[0].a: Iyo. Kibwaninu kionso kyabula kufuta, kakiyi kishima kya mushipidimu ne kintu nansha kimo kishiyile ku kulembula. Kadiya ka makuta kekapangulwapo nansha dimo.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: ayi. Kusoneka kukile kudi ko kubwele, kilembelo kya imel ke dikadiyi: wingila bikwaninu kyabula kutengidila.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: ayi. Mikanda yebe wingidijibwa kaka ku mwingilu wenzile, kupwa ifutwa. Kakiyi muntu ubatanga ne kebakasabanjibwapo.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Iyo. pdff iwingila pa kibwaninu kya kusakwila kya telefone yonso, tab lete nansha kompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), kakiyi kintu kya kulonga.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, mimfuanyi (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ne mikuabu.

strings.privacy.title: Buhashiki
strings.privacy.description: Mudi pdff ikwata mikanda yebe: kakiyi kashintulwilu, kakiyi mukanda ulamwa, kakiyi bilambu ne kwabana binenwa.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ibandwile mwanda mikanda yebe ikale yebe. Pano i binenwa byapelele, byakwata pa wingila.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mikanda yebe
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ituminwa mu bishintulwilu byalamwile (HTTPS), ilongolwa pa kwiya, kupwa ifutwa pa kuswa kwa bufumi. Mikanda mikile ipityila pa bulami bwa mu kitatyi kifyale ne kuzima pa kuswa kwa mwingilu; kuseba kwa kwiya kukosa byonso byakashala mu mafuku 26.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Kakiyi kashintulwilu, kakiyi binenwa bya muntu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff kepangulapo kashintulwilu, kilembelo kya imel nansha kadiya ka makuta. Mikanda yebe keibatangwapo, keshintululwapo, kebabanwapo nansha kwingidijibwa ku kufundija bwang'ombe bwa nshinda.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kutangila kwa bantu
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tutuleta bitangu bya bantu kyabula kulemba nansha kukwata malambu (Vercel Web Analytics) mwanda wa kuyuka bikwaninu bya kamweno. Kakiyi bilambu, kakiyi kutangila kwa pa bibwaninu.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Malambu a kusakwila
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kakokolu kamue, ka kusaka: kadi nuela mu lungenyi muakulu uudi musole.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Bulami
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Tshibanza etshi tshidi tshilama kudi Vercel pa bimba bia mu Paris; kuakula kua Word, Excel ne PowerPoint kudi kukuata kudi Render mu Frankfurt. Bidi bifila bitshikumu anu bua tshiyi tshia kuakula.

strings.legal.terms.title: Mikenji ya mudimu
strings.legal.terms.description: pdff nkayende mbwa bianza kudi bonso, kuakukila bisumbu ne mbulamatadi. Bitshikumu biebe bidi bia dianu: kakuena tshidi tshidi kufuanyikija peshi kulama.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Mikenji eyi idi ilomba mudimu wenu wa pdff. Idi miangate mukese ne mifunde muakulu mupepele. Pa kuenza mudimu ne tshibanza, udi wanyine.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Nganyi udi upatula pdff
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdff idi mifukidibue, mibungidibue ne mipatudibue kudi Mikailou Cedric Toure, mufukidi udi musombele mu New Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Mikenji ya bianza ya kuenza mudimu, kudi bonso
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdff nkayende mbwa bianza, kakuyi kuleja dîna ne kakuyi tshijima tshia tshiyi, kudi bonso: bantu bonso, balongi, balongishi, bisumbu, bisumbu biakumukamu, mbulamatadi ne baministe, mu Canada ne mu matunga mikuabu. Kakuena mudimu udi ulama ku mikenji ya makuabu, bualu kakuena. Bitshikumu biudi upatula bidi biebe bionso: kabiakena ne tshimanyinu peshi dîna dia pdff.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Bitshikumu biebe bionso, nansha bia bungi
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Udi mua kuenza mudimu ne tshikumu tshionso, nansha bia bungi, bualu pdff kayena ibala, kufuanyikija, ilama peshi ikaba bitshikumu biebe: bidi bienzekela mu mushindu wa kuikalaku ne bimushe. Udi mupianyi wabo, ne udi ne mudimu wa kuikala ne mikandu mikanyine ya kuenza nabio.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Tshibawu ne diangata pa bimba biebe
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Tshibawu tshia pdff tshidi kipatudibue ku mikenji ya MIT. Udi mua kubala, kubanda, kuangata pa bimba biebe (kuakukila ne mu tshibanza tshidi tshiyi ne Internet), kushintulula ne kupesha bantu bianza, pa kuikala ne tshimanyinu tshia mupianyi ne mikenji.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Mudimu mukanyine
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Kuvwile kuenza mudimu ne pdff bua malu mabi, kukeba kunyanga mudimu peshi kupita mikenji ya dianu. Bungi ne mibelu idi ilama mudimu kudi bonso.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Mudiwo
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdff mbwa bianza. Idi mua kushintulula, kukatuka bua kulongolola peshi kujika. Lama bitshikumu biebe bia kumpala: pdff kayena ilama tshimfuanyi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Bulami ne diandamuna
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Mudimu udi upesha mu “mudiwo”, kakuyi bulami buonso. Ku bungi bua mikenji, mufundi kayena udiamuna bua bungi bua nyanga, dijimija dia bitshikumu peshi dipanga dia kuakula. Tala bitshikumu biudi upatula kumpala kua kuenza nabio mudimu wa dikole.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Bintu bia lungenyi
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Dîna dia pdff, tshimanyinu tshiadi ne miaku ya tshibanza bidi bia mufundi; tshibawu tshidi ku mikenji ya MIT bu mudi mufunde. Mikenji ya dîna (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) idi ya ba mwene.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Mikenji ya buloba
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Mikenji eyi idi ilonda ya mu Tshitungu tshia New Brunswick ne ya mbulamatadi ya Canada. Bisumbu bia New Brunswick bidi ne bukole, kakuyi kubunda mikenji ya ditunga diebe.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Bishintulula
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Mikenji eyi idi mua kushintuluka. Dikeku didi pa mutu wa dibeji didi leja tshikumu tshidi tshimanyine; tshishintulula tshidi mua kuenza mudimu anu pashishe pa dipatuka.

strings.legal.security.title: Bukole ne bitshikumu
strings.legal.security.description: Ntshinyi tshidi tshienzeka ku bitshikumu biebe pa pdff: dienza mu mushindu wa kuikalaku, kakuyi kufuanyikija, dipusha dia lulolo, bulami, diangata pa bimba mu Europe, ne mushindu wa kuangata pa bimba biebe.
strings.legal.security.intro: Ntshinyi tshidi tshienzeka ku bitshikumu biebe, kadi bienza ne mudi biakanyine: kufunda mu bupepele, bua bantu bonso ne bisumbu.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Kakuena bitshikumu bilame
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Bitshikumu biebe bidi bienzeka mu mushindu wa kuikalaku, pashishe bimushe anu diambu dibidi bidi bikanyine peshi bipuekeshibue. Kakuena tshimfuanyi, kakuena dilama ne kakuena mushindo. Dipusha dia bulongololi dia ku matuku didi disha bitshikumu bia tshikondo, dîba dia kumpala.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Kakuena kufuanyikija
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Kakuena muntu udi abala bitshikumu biebe. Kabena babibadika, babiangata, babikaba peshi babienza bua kulongesha lungenyi lua bungeni. pdff kayena ne mazuza, kayena ne bibilu ne kayena ne bidi bilonda bantu.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Bulami
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Dibuela dionso didi lilama (HTTPS) ne tshibanza tshidi kilama dibuela dionso (HSTS). Tshibanza tshia Bulami tshidi kilama PDF biebe ne AES-256; mwa kukena uudi musole kakuena kulama.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Kudi bitshikumu biebe bienzeka
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Tshibanza, PDF ne mimfuanyi: Vercel, Paris data center (France, European Union). Word, Excel ne PowerPoint: Render, mu Frankfurt (Germany, European Union). Bitshikumu bipita 4 MB: Vercel Blob, ne dîna dia dikema, bimushe pashishe pa kuenza mudimu.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Bipesha bia bukole
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Bipesha bia bukole (HSTS, kuzuza tshibanza tshia kubuela ku matalatu mikuabu, bulami bwa mishindu ya bitshikumu), adi kadiyela ka bitshikumu bia tshikondo, ne mudimu wa dienza udi wanyine anu nkonko ya tshisokoko. Tshishintulula tshionso tshidi tshiswibwa mu mushindu wa kuikalaku (mateta, bidi biakanyine) kumpala kua kupatuka.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Dianu ne mikenji
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff idi ipatudibue mu New Brunswick ne idi ilonda mikenji ya Canada ya Malu a Bidi (PIPEDA). Kayena ikola malu a bantu a badi benza mudimu: kakuena mazuza, kakuena imela, kakuena tshikokolu tshia diata. Idi mibungidibue pa mikenji mimue ne ya Europe GDPR ne ya Quebec Law 25: kupuekesha malu, kakuyi dienza kabidi, dipusha pashishe pa dienza mudimu.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Bua bisumbu bia mikenji mikole
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Bidibi mikenji yenu ikaza kutuma bitshikumu ku tshibanza tshia ku ntshi, ikala pdff pa bimba biebe. Tshibawu tshijima mbwa bianza, tshia tshibawu tshia bonso ne tshidi tshienza mudimu kakuyi Internet: kakuena tshikumu tshidi tshipandula tshibanza chiebe. Mudiwo wa diangata udi pa tshibanza tshia mudimu.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Buakane
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Tshibawu tshijima tshia muakulu tshidi tshia bonso: bisumbu bienu bia bukole bidi mua kuteta mikenji eyi yonso.
strings.legal.security.sections[8].title: Fundisha tshilema
strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Udi wela meji nudi mupete tshilema tshia bukole? Fundisha mu tshisokoko ku tshibanza tshia “Bukole” tshia mudimu:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Bupuekele bwa kubuela
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Mudiwo wa bupuekele bwa kubuela wa pdff: WCAG 2.2 level AA, bipesha biudi, bilema bimanyine ne mudi mua kufundisha tshilema.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Bantu bonso badi ne bua kuenza mudimu ne pdff, kuakukila bantu badi bafofomuna peshi badi ne matalatu a mêna, badi ba matshi a dikema, peshi badi ne tshilema tshia bianza peshi lungenyi.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Tshikondo tshia kuikala
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff idi ikeba kulonda mikenji ya Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, ya W3C ya pa buloba bonso. Tshikondo etshi kadiakanyine malu a Mbulamatadi ya Canada, ya Europe EN 301 549 ne Section 508 ya United States, adi akula bua WCAG 2.0 peshi 2.1 level AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Bidi biakanyine
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff idi yakanyine kakese ne WCAG 2.2 level AA: bilema bimanyine bidi munshi. Mudiwo eu udi ushindamene pa dienza dia mukati diakenzekela pa October 2, 2026, ne bipesha bia dienza (axe, Lighthouse) ne mateta a bianza (tshibawu, lusekelo, buimbu, kuakula). Kakuena mateta a bionso a ku ntshi makeka.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Ntshinyi tshidi tshidilaku
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Tshibanza tshionso kudi tshitshina ne tshibawu, ne tshilema “Lubila ku bintu” ne tshimanyinu tshilekele pa tshintu tshidi tshitshina. Buimbu bwa miaku bidi 4.5:1. Mibelu ya mudimu (dipuekesha, bidi bifumine, tshilema) bidi biakula kudi balongi ba bidimu. Tshikondo tshia bitshikumu tshidi mua kushintuluka kakuyi kukoka, ne bintu. Tshibanza tshidi lilonda mudiwo wa tshiyangilu “kupuekesha bidi bitshina”: bidi bitshina bidi bijika. Matangilu adi ashalela a 400% buimbu ne pa mobile. Muakulu wa dibeji dionso udi muambibue, ne muakulu wa العربية udi uleja kufuma ku balume ku balume.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Bilema bimanyine
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Kakuyi mudiwo eu, bidi bitshina bia dienza (tshibanza, mukungulu, tshibawu tshia mishindu) bidi bienzeka; tshibawu tshidi tshijima pa kuikala ne tshibawu. Mukungulu wa ku dibeji dia kumpala udi wenzeka ne tshiyangilu peshi tshianza; mbu wa dienza, ne mulongo wa mishindu udi uleja udi kabidi muakulu pa dibeji. Miaku mikudimuna kudi mashinyi idi mua kuikala ne bilema.

strings.legal.accessibility.sections[4].text: Tshikalu tshia tshibanza tshiudi nakio tshilema? Fundisha ku tshibanza tshia mudimu; tudi tukeba kuandamuna mu matuku 10 a mudimu ne kupesha mushindu mukuabu bidi bikeba tshikondo tshileku:

strings.legal.install.description: Longolola pdff pa bimba bia mbulamatadi peshi tshisumbu chiebe: mbwa bianza, tshibawu tshia bonso, ne bitshikumu biebe kabena bafuma pa tshibanza chiebe.

strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Bala mazu a PDF wa kukula nansha kifwatulo (OCR) bua ukebike, ukope nansha kubala mukulu. Nkaya 16, patupu, mukanda kawena upanduka.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Mukanda wa kukula nansha kifwatulo ntu anu kifwatulo: kuena mua kukeba dî nansha kukopa tshikoso. Bala mukanda wa kukula udi umanya balugulu bonso (bidi biamba OCR) ne unena mazu malelela pa mukanda kakuyi kusesula mudiwo kumoneka. Kubala kudi kuenzeka pa mashini wobe: mukanda wobe kawena upanduka. Anu tshilepelu tshia muoyo tshia nkaya ya nangulula (MB mîkôye) ndiapudibua musangu umue.
